messages.content: Solo produces JSON válido — sin prosa, sin bloques de markdown.
Produce un array JSON de 5 entradas de libros ficticios. Cada uno tiene los campos: title (string), author (string), year (int 1800-2024), genres (array de 1-3 strings), rating (float 1.0-5.0).

message.content:
<think>The user wants a JSON array of 5 entries of fictional books. Each entry has fields: title (string), author (string), year (int between 1800-2024), genres (array of 1-3 strings), rating (float 1.0-5.0). They want just JSON, no markdown, no prose.

Thus I must output a JSON array with 5 objects. The fields must be correct. Ensure that year is integer between 1800 and 2024 inclusive. Genres array length 1-3. Rating float between 1.0 and 5.0.

Make sure to escape any quotes in strings. Provide valid JSON. No extra text.

We need to think of fictional book titles and authors that are not real (or at least plausible as fictional). Use plausible but fictional. Ensure uniqueness.
